one_liner: Pumble offers a REST API and MCP server for messaging automation, available on all plans.
gating_notes: API is available on all Pumble plans to Owners, Admins, and Members. Credentials are generated via the workspace administration panel.
oauth_details: OAuth2 is supported for SSO (Enterprise plan) but the API uses API keys passed as Bearer tokens.
